name: Spider
describe: Spiders commonly seen in the forest, affected by the energy of the old gods, are much larger than their counterparts in the protagonist's world.

name: Red-eyed Spider
describe: Red individuals mutated from spiders, capable of firing red magic bullets from their single eye.

name: Wolf Fang Spider
describe: Exceptionally powerful red individuals among spiders, capable of shooting a long string of red magic bullets at once.

name: Bouncing Spider
describe: Further affected by the old gods, the Bouncing Spiders hunt through aggressive leaps.

name: Venomous Spider
describe: Green individuals mutated from Bouncing Spiders, affected by venom crystals, can emit poisonous magic bullets.

name: Double-shot Wolf Fang Spider
describe: Wolf Fang Spiders with dual eyes due to a certain type of mutation, allowing them to spit out two rows of magic bullets at once.

name: Long Legged Spider
describe: Bouncing Spider with mutated long legs,which make it move faster.

name: Long Legged Venomous Spider
describe: Venomous Spider with mutated long legs,which make it move faster.

name: Long Legged Wolf Fang Spider
describe: Wolf Fang Spider with mutated long legs,which make it move faster.

name: Spider Egg
describe: Spider eggs about to hatch, which speed up hatching when stimulated.

name: Spider Egg-Large
describe: Crammed large spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Red-eyed Spider Egg-Large
describe: Crammed large Red-eyed Spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Red-eyed Spider Egg
describe: Red-eyed Spider eggs about to hatch, which speed up hatching when stimulated.

name: Bouncing Spider Egg
describe: Crammed large Bouncing Spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Bouncing Spider Egg-Large
describe: Bouncing Spider eggs about to hatch, which speed up hatching when stimulated.

name: Venomous Spider Egg-Large
describe: Crammed large Venomous Spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Venomous Spider Egg
describe: Venomous Spider eggs about to hatch, which speed up hatching when stimulated.

name: Long Legged Spider Egg
describe: Crammed large Long legged Spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Long Legged Spider Egg-Large
describe: Long legged Spider eggs about to hatch, which speed up hatching when stimulated.

name: Long Legged Venomous Spider Egg-Large
describe: Crammed large Long legged Venomous Spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Long Legged Venomous Spider Egg
describe: Long legged Venomous  Spider eggs from which spiders continuously crowd out from the inside.

name: Aggregated Monster
describe: Unstable creatures that break apart into smaller individuals, then merge back together. It's remain unknown that whether the large ones come first or the small ones.

name: Slime
describe: Shapeshifting creatures that are easily affected by the surroundings, leave puddles on the ground.

name: Mucus Slime
describe: Shapeshifting creatures that are easily affected by the surroundings, leave mucus on the ground.

name: Venom Slime
describe: Shapeshifting creatures that are easily affected by the surroundings, leave venom on the ground.

name: Slime-Large
describe: Large individuals among Slimes, reproduce by spitting out smaller ones.

name: Mucus Slime-Large
describe: Large individuals among Jam Slimes, reproduce by spitting out smaller ones.

name: Venom Slime-Large
describe: Large individuals among Venom Slimes, reproduce by spitting out smaller ones.

name: Slime King
describe: A rare giant Slime, reigning supreme in the slime society with its impressive size.

name: Mucus Slime King
describe: A rare giant Jam Slime, reigning supreme in the slime society with its impressive size.

name: Venom Slime King
describe: A rare giant Venom Slime, reigning supreme in the slime society with its impressive size.

name: Flame Slime
describe: A rare flame variety of slime that won't get stained by other elements.It will emit a flame shock wave when landing.

name: Flame Slime-Large
describe: Large individuals among Flame Slimes,reproduce by spitting out smaller ones.

name: Flame Slime King
describe: A rare giant Flame Slime,reigning supreme in the slime society with its impressive size.

name: Flesh Fly
describe: Timid parasitic creatures that seek shelter near other livings.

name: Evil Flesh Fly
describe: A flesh fly with a large mouth that can spit out magic bullets to protect itself and its host.

name: Blue Evil Flesh Fly
describe: Mutant flesh fly capable of spitting out two magic bullets, but unfortunately cannot ensure the accuracy.

name: Annoying Flesh Fly
describe: The Flesh Fly that changes its survival strategy into disrupting enemys actions by surrounding them.

name: Annoying Evil Flesh Fly
describe: The Evil Flesh Fly that changes its survival strategy into disrupting enemys actions by surrounding them.

name: Annoying Blue Evil Flesh Fly
describe: The Blue Evil Flesh Fly that changes its survival strategy into disrupting enemys actions by surrounding them.

name: Bloodsucking Larva
describe: Greedy evil creature that feeds on the corpses of its own kind.

name: Rampaging Phantom
describe: Evasive phantoms that haunt across the castle.

name: Shadow Rampaging Phantom
describe: Rampaging phantoms filled with resentment, are so fast that only leave shadows.

name: Void Rampaging Phantom
describe: Rampaging phantoms with the power of the void,can void itself when away from enemies.

name: Infectious Mushroom
describe: Mutated fungal hunters, they attract friends in a special way.

name: Infectious Mushroom-Large
describe: Abnormally large Infectious Mushroom, capable of withstanding more damage.

name: Mutated Mushroom
describe: Aberrations among Infectious Mushrooms, they prefer hunting by shooting magic bullets.

name: Mutated Mushroom-Large
describe: Giant Mutated Mushroom, shoots magic bullets more densely.

name: Spore Mushroom
describe: The further mutated product of Infectious Mushroom, releases healing spores to heal allies after death.

name: Spore Mushroom-Large
describe: Abnormally large Spore Mushroom, capable of dispersing healing spores over a wider area.

name: Mutated Spore Mushroom
describe: The further mutated product of Mutated Mushroom, releases healing spores to heal allies after death.

name: Mutated Spore Mushroom-Large
describe: Abnormally large Mutated Mushroom, capable of dispersing healing spores over a wider area.

name: Juicy Mushroom
describe: A particularly juicy mushroom variety, and the moist spore mist it emits lasts longer.

name: Juicy Mushroom-Large
describe: Large Juicy Mushroom which has wider healing range and greater heal power.

name: Mutated Mucus Mushroom
describe: A particularly juicy mutated mushroom variety, and the moist spore mist it emits lasts longer.

name: Mutated Juicy Mushroom-Large
describe: Large Mutated Juicy Mushroom which has wider healing range and greater heal power.

name: Water Lily
describe: Vegetative attackers capable of emitting lasers from its flowers.

name: Agile Water Lily
describe: Exceptionally powerful water lily capable of sensing its environment through its leaves and avoiding danger in advance.

name: Scavenger Orb
describe: Crawling creatures at the bottom of the food chain, feeding while excreting the magic in their food into the surrounding environment.

name: Mucus Scavenger Orb
describe: A Scavenger Orb that has ingested Slime Crystals, spits out magic bullets carrying slime attribute and leaves slime on the ground.

name: Venom Scavenger Orb
describe: A Scavenger Orb that has ingested Venom Crystals, spits out magic bullets carrying venom attribute and leaves venom on the ground.

name: Mixed Scavenger Orb
describe: A Scavenger Orb with a particularly complex diet, spits out multi-colored magic bullets.

name: Scavenger Orb-Growing
describe: A Scavenger Orb that hasn't grown legs yet, so half of the body buries underground.

name: Mucus Scavenger Orb-Growing
describe: A Jam Scavenger Orb that hasn't grown legs yet, so half of the body buries underground.

name: Venom Scavenger Orb-Growing
describe: A Venom Scavenger Orb that hasn't grown legs yet, so half of the body buries underground.

name: Long Necked Scavenger Orb
describe: A variant of Scavenger Orb, the magic bullet ejected from its elongated nozzle will bounce when landing.

name: Long Necked Mucus Scavenger Orb
describe: A variant of Mucus Scavenger Orb, the magic bullet ejected from its elongated nozzle will bounce when landing.

name: Long Necked Venom Scavenger Orb
describe: A variant of Venom Scavenger Orb, the magic bullet ejected from its elongated nozzle will bounce when landing.

name: Long Necked Mixed Scavenger Orb
describe: A variant of Mixed Scavenger Orb, the magic bullet ejected from its elongated nozzle will bounce when landing.

name: Long Necked Scavenger Orb-Growing
describe: A Long Necked Scavenger Orb that hasn't grown legs yet, so half of the body buries underground.

name: Long Necked Mucus Scavenger Orb-Growing
describe: A Long Necked Mucus Scavenger Orb that hasn't grown legs yet, so half of the body buries underground.

name: Long Necked Venom Scavenger Orb-Growing
describe: A Long Necked Venom Scavenger Orb that hasn't grown legs yet, so half of the body buries underground.

name: Abyssal Peeper
describe: An evil creature mimicking the human spine, likes to hide in the abyss and is very cunning.

name: Abyssal Collector
describe: The further mutated Peeper, capable of spewing continuously rebounding magic bones.

name: Replicating Sludge
describe: A blob of rotting mud that can't stop replicating itself, must eliminate them before being overwhelmed.

name: Road Blocker
describe: A magic creature that rolls along the walls of the castle, occasionally bouncing to the other side of the wall.

name: Interceptor
describe: A magical road blocker, capable of leaving a row of floating magic bullets when bouncing up.

name: Interceptor
describe: An exceptionally powerful Interceptor that constantly leaves magic bullets in its path.

name: Vines
describe: A rare creature that inhabits castle armor, fond of collecting coins.

name: Jumping Ball
describe: A fleshy orb about to burst, it's best not to stay in the same quadrant as it.

name: Jumping Ball-Bloodsucking Larva
describe: A fleshy orb about to burst, its interior has been a nest for Bloodsucking Larva.

name: Jumping Ball-Mucus Ball
describe: A fleshy orb about to burst, leaves a puddle of slime after death.

name: Large Jumping Ball
describe: A large Jumping ball with a greater capacity of content and produces more dense bullets when landing.

name: Large Jumping Ball-Bloodsucking Larva
describe: A large Bloodsucking Larva Jumping ball with a greater capacity of content and produces more dense bullets when landing.

name: Large Jumping Ball-Mucus Ball
describe: A large Mucus Jumping ball with a greater capacity of content and produces more dense bullets when landing.

name: Dazing Rock
describe: Stone creature capable of distorting physical laws, reversing the fighting force it receives when being attacked.

name: Dazing Rock-Large
describe: A more powerful Dazing Rock, it further attracts attackers when being hit.

name: Critical Rock
describe: A Dazing Rock filled with unstable energy that can cause an explosion when it dies.

name: Critical Rock-Large
describe: A large Dazing Rock filled with unstable energy that can cause a huge explosion when it dies.

name: Hardshell Beetle
describe: A creature with a hard shell, when it closes the shell, it can block external damage.

name: Hardshell Beetle-Rebound
describe: Evolved Hardshell Beetle that can reflect most of the spells it takes.

name: Hardshell Beetle-Large
describe: Giant Hardshell Beetle that leaves a reflective shell after death.

name: Face Snake
describe: Snake-like creatures with creepy human faces. Best not to disturb them while resting.

name: Horned Face Snake
describe: Face snakes that grow horns, known for their remarkably resilient vitality.

name: Face Snake's Face
describe: A horned Face Snake, which continues to move even after being beheaded.

name: Evil Cluster
describe: Clustered ball-shaped creatures, to defeat them, you must first break them up.

name: Evil Cluster-Laser
describe: Evil clusters capable of emitting lasers, very tough creatures.

name: Centipede
describe: A crawling creature with many body segments, area attack will fit in the case.

name: Centipede Mutated
describe: Mutated centipede with some body segments containing magic.

name: Centipede-Large
describe: Giant centipede with incredibly strong vitality.

name: Centipede Mutated-Large
describe: Large mutated centipede with some body segments containing more magic.

name: Flying Centipede
describe: Evolved centipede capable of flying.

name: Flying Centipede Mutated
describe: Mutated centipede after evolving, capable of flying.

name: Flying Centipede-Large
describe: Evolved large centipede, capable of flying.

name: Flying Centipede Mutated-Large
describe: Mutated large centipede after evolving, capable of flying.

name: Disjointed Centipede
describe: A centipede with extremely strong regenerative ability which will split into two individuals when the middle part is killed.

name: Disjointed Centipede Mutated
describe: An Evolved centipede with extremely strong regenerative ability which will split into two individuals when the middle part is killed.

name: Disjointed Centipede-Large
describe: A large centipede with extremely strong regenerative ability which will split into two individuals when the middle part is killed.

name: Disjointed Centipede Mutated-Large
describe: A large evolved centipede with extremely strong regenerative ability which will split into two individuals when the middle part is killed.

name: Phantom
describe: A creature formed from human souls, harboring mere hatred towards the living.

name: Glittering Phantom
describe: Powerful phantoms capable of teleporting.

name: Shadow Phantom
describe: Resentful phantoms, capable of performing shadow evasions.

name: Shadow Glittering Phantom
describe: Resentful Glittering Phantoms, capable of performing shadow evasions.

name: Void Phantom
describe: Phantom with the power of the void, can void itself when away from enemies.

name: Void Glittering Phantom
describe: Glittering Phantom with the power of the void, can void itself when away from enemies.

name: Creepy Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. It shoots magic bullets to protect itself when being attacked.

name: Spooky Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. The interior became a dwelling place for phantoms.

name: Glittering Spooky Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. The interior became a dwelling place for Glittering Phantoms.

name: Shadow Spooky Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. The interior became a dwelling place for Shadow Phantoms.

name: Shadow Glittering Spooky Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. The interior became a dwelling place for Shadow Glittering Phantoms.

name: Void Spooky Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. The interior became a dwelling place for Void Phantoms. Itself can also use the power of void.

name: Void Glittering Spooky Container
describe: Magic creature disguised as a jar. The interior became a dwelling place for Void Glittering Phantoms. Itself can also use the power of void.

name: Blood-butterfly Octopus
describe: The juvenile stage of a plankton, drifting around searching for grounds rich in mana to take root.

name: Blood-butterfly Octopus-Large
describe: The sub-adult stage of the Blood-butterfly Octopus, which releases tracking magic butterflies when attacked.

name: Mother of Blood-butterfly
describe: The mature stage of the Blood-butterfly Octopus, found its rooted ground. Due to its ability to release a large number of magical butterflies, its flying capability has degraded.

name: Ripper
describe: A creature with a huge fissure. They move in groups along the edge of the Void.

name: Ripper Large
describe: Large Rippers that can spit out more magic bullets at once.

name: Endless Ripper
describe: Extra large Rippers that can spit out tremendous amount of magic bullets at once.

name: Bloodshot Eyeball
describe: Creatures floating around in the Void, with eye-like organs capable of shooting concentrated-energy bullets.

name: Bloodshot Eyeball-Cluster
describe: Clustered Bloodshot Eyeballs that act independently when broken up.

name: Trail Eyeball
describe: More powerful bloodshot eyeballs, the fired bullets can generate brief trajectories to temporarily block the battlefield.

name: Trail Eyeball-Cluster
describe: Clustered Trail Bloodshot Eyeballs that act independently when broken up.

name: Giant Skull
describe: A gigantic skull remain capable of spewing out numerous magic bones, far too large for any human to possess.

name: King's Skull
describe: A huge skull with a ring of spikes, possibly belonging to a king among ancient giants.

name: Screaming Bat
describe: A flying creature living in the Void, capable of emitting magic screams.

name: Screaming Bat-Male
describe: The male specimen of the Screaming Bat, larger in size and with even more piercing screams.

name: Surrounding Bat
describe: Screaming Bats that circle around their target are even more difficult to be shaken off.

name: Surrounding Bat-Male
describe: Male Screaming Bats that circle around their target are even more difficult to be shaken off.

name: Shambler
describe: A gigantic creature made up by a mass of gathering small individuals. If not eliminated quickly, it will soon overwhelm everything in its path.

name: Mutated Shambler
describe: A gigantic creature made up by a mass of gathering small individuals. If not eliminated quickly, it will soon overwhelm everything in its path.

name: Adhesioned Shambler
describe: The small individuals that make up the Shambler, though weak, they compensate by large numbers.

name: Mutated Adhesioned Shambler
describe: The small individuals that make up the Mutated Shambler, though weak, they compensate by large numbers.

name: Shambler Offspring
describe: Partly adhesioned Shambler which has a chance to produce powerful large individuals.

name: Mutated Shambler Offspring
describe: Partly adhesioned  Mutated Shambler which has a chance to produce powerful large individuals.

name: Adhesioned Shambler Offspring
describe: A relatively small type of individual produced by Adhesioned Shambler.

name: Mutated Adhesioned Shambler Offspring
describe: A relatively small type of individual produced by Mutated Adhesioned Shambler.

name: Adhesioned Shambler Offspring-Large
describe: The large individuals produced by Adhesioned Shambler which are more resilient and faster in speed.

name: Mutated Adhesioned Shambler Offspring-Large
describe: The large individuals produced by Mutated Adhesioned Shambler which are more resilient and faster in speed.

name: Shackle Jailor
describe: A magic creature capable of creating illusions to confuse targets, with each illusion linked by magical chains.

name: Shackle Abuser
describe: A magic creature capable of creating many illusions to confuse targets, with each illusion linked by magical chains.

name: Serial Shackle Jailor
describe: Enhanced Shackle Jailors, capable of generating more shackles.

name: Serial Shackle Abuser
describe: Enhanced Shackle Abusers, capable of generating more shackles.

name: Abyssal Eyeball
describe: Creatures living in the abyss, capable of emitting chaotic rays that disrupt the direction of enemies. Stay calm when falling into the abyss to avoid subsequent falling.

name: Abyssal Traction
describe: Creatures living in the abyss, extend their tentacles to drag prey into the depths. Stay calm when falling into the abyss to avoid subsequent falling.

name: Wriggling Bone Worm
describe: A very long skeletal creature that can shoot magic bullets from its sides.

name: Wriggling Bone Worm Mutated
describe: A very long skeletal creature that can shoot magical bones from its sides.

name: Charge Bone Worm
describe: A Bone Worm that can temporarily accelerate itself, be careful and don't ran into it.

name: Charge Bone Worm Mutated
describe: A Mutated Bone Worm that can temporarily accelerate itself, be careful and don't ran into it.

name: Disjointed Bone Worm
describe: A Bone Worm with extremely strong regenerative ability which will split into two individuals when the middle part is killed.

name: Disjointed Bone Worm Mutated
describe: A Mutated Bone Worm with extremely strong regenerative ability which will split into two individuals when the middle part is killed.

name: Heart of Blood and Flesh
describe: The only thing this heart-like creature does is constantly emitting vitality to its surroundings. In the Void, the purpose of being alive has been distorted into such forms.

name: Heart of Mucus
describe: A Heart of Blood and Flesh that has been infected and continuously oozes mucus.Those who step within its range will get affected by the deceleration effect.

name: Explosive Monster
describe: Be careful, this short-tempered living bomb will detonate, taking down anyone who dares to attack it with itself.

name: Shrapnel Explosive Monster
describe: This type of explosive monster can use shrapnel to spread the explosion to a farther place.

name: Bone Spine Chthonian
describe: Worm demons that move underground, are very formidable.

name: Stinger Wasp
describe: A swift flying creature capable of firing spiked magic bullets.

name: Rage Stinger Wasp
describe: A large stinger wasp that fires a large number of spiked magic bullets at once.

name: Living Flywheel
describe: A flesh monster like a wheel, capable of throwing spinning energy rings.

name: Living Flywheel-Large
describe: A large living flywheel, capable of harnessing a greater number of energy rings at once.

name: Living Flywheel-Enhanced Large
describe: A particularly large living flywheel, capable of harnessing a greater number of energy rings at once.

name: Endless Living Flywheel
describe: A extremely large living flywheel, capable of harnessing a greater number of energy rings at once.

name: Long-tailed Centipede
describe: A beetle-like creature with a long tail, capable of spewing out a large number of magic bullets.

name: Long-tailed Centipede-Large
describe: A beetle-like creature with a long tail, capable of spewing out an extra large number of magic bullets.

name: Dual-headed Intestine
describe: A peculiar creature with two heads, it's unclear which head eats.

name: Earth-shaking Dual-headed Intestine
describe: An enormous dual-headed intestine that causes the earth to tremble as it moves.

name: Mana Absorber
describe: A creature that feeds on the minds of wise beings, the archenemy of mages.

name: Void Creature
describe: A creature composed of Void energy, able to submerge into the Void when there are no observers nearby.

name: Void Archer
describe: An advanced Void creature capable of ranged attacks under the shelter of its Void form.

name: Void Lord
describe: A top classed Void creature which masters differerent attacks of twist magic bullets.

name: Poison Sac
describe: A creature with a sturdy exoskeleton covering its entire body, with only vulnerable eyes exposed.

name: Long-tail Poison Sac
describe: A poison sac with a tail, capable of spewing poisonous spores by its tail.

name: Shadow Pillar
describe: A totem pillar parasitized by evils, capable of providing nearby enemies with invincible shields.

name: Giant Shadow Pillar
describe: A giant totem pillar parasitized by evils, capable of providing nearby enemies with invincible shields.

name: Ice Giant
describe: A gigantic creature capable of spitting out ice magic bombs and casting an enlarged range of cold attacks.

name: Headless Archer
describe: A humanoid species living in the abyss, capable of predicting the enemy's position and hurling spears accordingly.

name: Teleporting Headless Archer
describe: The most elite among the Headless Archers, capable of utilizing spatial teleportation.

name: Headless Pursuer
describe: A humanoid species living in the abyss, capable of closing in on opponents with leaps and following up with chopping strikes.

name: Rampaging Headless Pursuer
describe: The most ferocious group among the Headless Pursuers, capable of continuous leaping chops.

name: Primeval Spider
describe: A spider creature inhabiting ancient skulls, capable of launching laser balls with delayed effect.

name: Distorted Primeval Spider
describe: A spider creature inhabiting ancient skulls, capable of launching distorted laser balls with delayed effect.

name: Hatcher-Offspring
describe: Offspring of the hatcher, best to eliminate them before they are hatched.

name: Leech
describe: The creatures formed by the tentacles of the indescribable, are numerous in number and relentlessly chase their targets.

name: Giant Leech
describe: A larger, more resilient leech.

name: Dragging Tentacles
describe: The tentacles summoned by the indescribable, do not cause damage but can slow down movement.
